biotools.summary: mehenDi is a data-driven differential testing method for RNA-seq that utilizes a hierarchical tree structure to maximize biological resolution while retaining statistical power. It identifies differentially expressed transcripts and inner nodes, providing a more comprehensive analysis than traditional methods.
